original_test_intent: Exercise GPUDirect traffic through both designated ConnectX-8 400G Ethernet ports with NVQual Test #38 and prove each link and the aggregate 2x400G path meet approved integrity, performance and stability requirements without port flap, device fault, hang or reboot.
original_method: Bind GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/BDF, port MACs/netdevs, two switch/peer paths and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU topology; verify both links at 400G with approved Ethernet, MTU, routing and bonding or independent-flow semantics; pin per-port flow placement, directions, payloads, queues/streams, concurrency and duration; isolate both paths; capture raw per-port and aggregate traffic/integrity/congestion plus GPU/NIC/PCIe/network health; fail the run on a silent single-port fallback, unacceptable imbalance or first fault without retry.
manual_activity: Owner/network engineer maps and isolates both 400G paths, approves bonding or independent-flow behavior and balance limits, and owns switch, HCA and peer recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual Test #38 profile and compatible GPU/ConnectX-8/CUDA/DOCA/MOFED stack
GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/BDF, both MAC/netdev/physical-port identities, two switch and peer paths, and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Both 400G Ethernet link modes, MTU/routing/VLAN, bonding or flow-placement policy and GPUDirect registration proof
Per-port and aggregate bandwidth/latency/integrity/balance/congestion/error/thermal limits, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated drained SUT and isolate both non-production 400G Ethernet paths
Preserve both ports' link, switch, NIC, PCIe and host counter baselines
Do not alter production routing/LAG policy, reset the HCA/GPU/switch or clear evidence outside the approved recipe
Stop on single-port fallback, unacceptable imbalance, loss/corruption, congestion, link flap, AER/NIC/GPU fault, thermal/power excursion, hang or reboot
agent_execution_scope: Verify both physical port/peer paths, active modes, GDR path, flow distribution, workload and limits
Run only the approved Test #38 dual-port profile on isolated links
Collect raw per-port and aggregate traffic/integrity plus switch, link, device and platform evidence
Do not infer bonding semantics, accept aggregate throughput without both-port proof, reset/reconfigure after fault, retry automatically or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #38 profile, exact two-port topology and bonding versus independent-flow contract
Define per-port and aggregate workload, balance, integrity, performance, congestion and error limits with aborts/recovery
Review complete evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It names the relevant vendor GPU Direct test but omits the exact two-port profile, mapping, traffic-distribution semantics and per-port limits; aggregate output alone cannot prove dual-port coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned Test #38 dual-port profile only after both 400G paths and GDR registration are verified, retaining independent per-port and aggregate traffic, integrity, balance, congestion and health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #38, dual-port 2x400G Ethernet GPU Direct mode, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/60-minute allocation remain; missing network and traffic values are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove the two physical paths separately, pin flow-to-port placement, and judge per-port integrity/performance before aggregate behavior so a healthy port cannot hide an idle or failing peer.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit port/switch/peer identity, Ethernet and distribution policy, per-port balance and error limits, direct-path proof, isolation and coordinated recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An aggregate score can pass with one port underused, traffic hashed to one link, a wrong peer, host-memory staging or compensating imbalance between a clean and erroring path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Two simultaneous 400G streams can saturate HCA, GPU, PCIe and switch buffers and may affect two failure domains or shared network policy.

project_override_considerations: An equivalent benchmark may substitute only if it proves GPUDirect on both approved 400G ports and retains separate plus aggregate results under the approved distribution policy. One-port, IB, host-memory or aggregate-only testing does not replace this case.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #38 package/profile and owner/network authorization
GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/BDF, both physical ports/MACs/netdevs, switch/peer paths and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Both 400G negotiated states, MTU/routing/VLAN and bonding or flow-placement configuration plus GDR proof
Raw per-port and aggregate direction/message/queue throughput, latency, balance and payload-integrity results
Both switch/peer congestion/drop/error counters plus NIC/GPU/PCIe/driver/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence
Abort/recovery or verified clean final two-port state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #38 Procedure, Criteria and same-row reviews consistently target dual-port 2x400G Ethernet GPUDirect. Missing port/distribution/profile details are readiness inputs, not conflicting objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-port Ethernet GPUDirect purpose is clear. Tooling, exact topology and acceptance limits are identifiable prerequisites rather than a permanent blocker.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2144 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00021-V002: approve the pinned NVQual Test #38 profile, GPU UUID/BDF and ConnectX-8 serial/BDF with both physical ports/MACs/netdevs, switch/peer and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map, verified 2x400G Ethernet plus MTU/routing/bonding or flow-placement and GPUDirect mode, per-port/aggregate workload, balance/performance/integrity/congestion/error/thermal limits, isolation, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Separates the two 400G paths so aggregate success cannot mask an idle, misrouted, imbalanced or faulting port, while preserving direct-memory and platform-health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Dual-port coverage is not implied by an 800G-class aggregate number: flow hashing, routing or tool selection can place nearly all data on one port. Each physical port must therefore have a pinned peer and independently measurable traffic and integrity result, followed by an aggregate concurrency check. Port balance is interpreted only under an approved distribution policy because equal sharing is not always the intended LAG or flow behavior.
